verses.geez:
ወኀደጎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለእሉ ፡ አሕዛብ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያመክሮሙ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ኢያእመሩ ፡ ኵሎ
                  ፡ ፀብኦሙ ፡ ለከናአን ።
verses.translation: And these are the nations which the Lord left to prove Israel with them, all that had not known the wars of Chanaan.

translations.lxx: And these are the nations which the Lord left to prove Israel with them, all that had not known the wars of Chanaan.
translations.kjv: Now these are the nations which the LORD left, to prove Israel by them, even as many of Israel as had not known all the wars of Canaan;
translations.ron: Iată popoarele acelea pe care le-a lăsat Domnul ca să ispitească prin ele pe Israel şi pe toţi aceia care nu cunoşteau toate războaiele Canaanului;

verses.geez:
ዳእሙ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ትውልዶሙ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ይምሀርዎሙ ፡ ቀትለ ፡ ወባሕቱ ፡ እለ ፡ እምቅድሜሆሙኒ ፡
                  ኢያአመርዎሙ ።
verses.translation: Only for the sake of the generations of Israel, to teach them war, only the men before them knew them not.

translations.lxx: Only for the sake of the generations of Israel, to teach them war, only the men before them knew them not.
translations.kjv: Only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at the least such as before knew nothing thereof;
translations.ron: Pe care le lăsase numai pentru ca generaţiile viitoare de oameni ale fiilor lui Israel să ştie şi să înveţe războiul pe care nu-l cunoscuseră mai înainte:

verses.geez:
ለእሉ ፡ ኀምስቱ ፡ አሕዛበ ፡ አሎፍሊ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ከናአን ፡ ወሲዶና ፡ ወኤዌዎን ፡ እለ ፡ ይነብሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ኢባኖስ ፡
                  እምነ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ባላሄርሞን ፡ እስከ ፡ ሎቤመት ።
verses.translation: The five lordships of the Phylistines, and every Chananite, and the Sidonian, and the Evite who dwelt in Libanus from the mount of Aermon to Laboemath.

translations.lxx: The five lordships of the Phylistines, and every Chananite, and the Sidonian, and the Evite who dwelt in Libanus from the mount of Aermon to Laboemath.
translations.kjv: Namely, five lords of the Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites that dwelt in mount Lebanon, from mount Baalhermon unto the entering in of Hamath.
translations.ron: Cinci stăpânitori Filisteni, toţi Canaaneii, Sidonienii şi Heveii care locuiau în munţii Libanului de la muntele Baal-Hermon până la intrarea Hamatului.

verses.geez:
ወተርፉ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያመክሮሙ ፡ ቦሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ከመ ፡ ያእምር ፡ እመ ፡ ይሰምዑ ፡ ትእዛዘ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ዘአዘዞሙ ፡ ለአበዊሆሙ ፡ በእደ ፡ ሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And this was done in order to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would obey the commands of the Lord, which he charged their fathers by the hand of Moses.

translations.lxx: And this was done in order to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would obey the commands of the Lord, which he charged their fathers by the hand of Moses.
translations.kjv: And they were to prove Israel by them, to know whether they would hearken unto the commandments of the LORD, which he commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
translations.ron: Acestea fuseseră lăsate ca să se încerce prin ele Israeliţii şi să se afle dacă se supun ei poruncilor Domnului, pe care le-a dat El părinţilor lor prin Moise.

verses.geez: ወነበሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ከናኔዎን ፡ ወኬጤዎን ፡ ወአሞሬዎን ፡ ወፌሬዜዎን ፡ ወኤዌዎን ፡ ወኢያቡሴዎን ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel dwelt in the midst of the Chananite, and the Chettite, and the Amorite, and the Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Jebusite.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel dwelt in the midst of the Chananite, and the Chettite, and the Amorite, and the Pherezite, and the Evite, and the Jebusite.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel dwelt among the Canaanites, Hittites, and Amorites, and Perizzites, and Hivites, and Jebusites:
translations.ron: Şi au trăit fiii lui Israel între Canaanei, Hetei, Amorei, Ferezei, Hevei, Gherghesei şi Iebusei,

verses.geez: ወነሥኡ ፡ አዋልዲሆሙ ፡ አውሰቡ ፡ ወአዋልዲሆሙ ፡ ወሀቡ ፡ ለደቂቆሙ ፡ ወአምለኩ ፡ ለአማልክቲሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And they took their daughters for wives to themselves, and they gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.

translations.lxx: And they took their daughters for wives to themselves, and they gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
translations.kjv: And they took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their daughters to their sons, and served their gods.
translations.ron: Şi şi-au luat femei din fetele acelora şi pe fetele lor le-au dat după feciorii acelora şi au slujit dumnezeilor lor.

verses.geez:
ወገብሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እኩየ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወረስዕዎ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አምላኮሙ ፡ ወአምለኩ ፡
                  በዓልም ፡ ወአምሳሊሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgot the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the Lord, and forgot the Lord their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil in the sight of the LORD, and forgat the LORD their God, and served Baalim and the groves.
translations.ron: Deci au făcut rele înaintea ochilor Domnului fiii lui Israel şi au uitat pe Domnul Dumnezeul lor şi au slujit baalilor şi astartelor.

verses.geez:
ወተምዕዐ ፡ መዐተ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወአግብኦሙ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እደ ፡ ኩሳ ፡ አርሳቴም ፡ ንጉሠ ፡
                  ሶርያ ፡ ዘሜሶጶጦምያ ፡ አፍላግ ፡ ወተቀንዩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለኩሳ ፡ አርሳቴም ፡ ሰማንተ ፡ ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and sold them into the hand of Chusarsathaim king of Syria of the rivers: and the children of Israel served Chusarsathaim eight years.

translations.lxx: And the Lord was very angry with Israel, and sold them into the hand of Chusarsathaim king of Syria of the rivers: and the children of Israel served Chusarsathaim eight years.
translations.kjv: Therefore the anger of the LORD was hot against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia: and the children of Israel served Chushanrishathaim eight years.
translations.ron: Atunci s-a aprins mânia Domnului asupra lui Israel şi i-a dat în mâinile lui Cuşan-Rişeataim, regele Mesopotamiei, şi fiii lui Israel au robit lui Cuşan-Rişeataim opt ani.

verses.geez:
ወገዐሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአቀመ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡
                  ወአድኀኖሙ ፡ ጎቶንየል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ቄኔዝ ፡ እኁሁ ፡ ለካሌብ ፡ ዘይንእስ ፡ ወተአዘዙ ፡ ሎቱ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord; and the Lord raised up a saviour to Israel, and he saved them, Gothoniel the son of Kenez, the brother of Chaleb younger than himself.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord; and the Lord raised up a saviour to Israel, and he saved them, Gothoniel the son of Kenez, the brother of Chaleb younger than himself.
translations.kjv: And when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised up a deliverer to the children of Israel, who delivered them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.
translations.ron: După aceea au strigat fiii lui Israel către Domnul şi a ridicat Domnul un izbăvitor pentru fiii lui Israel, care i-a izbăvit şi anume pe Otniel, fiul lui Chenaz, fratele mai mic al lui Caleb.

verses.geez:
ወኮነ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ መንፈሰ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወወፅአ ፡ ፀብአ ፡ ወአግብኦ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡
                  ውስተ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ ለኩሳ ፡ አርሳቴም ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሶርያ ።
verses.translation: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war against Chusarsathaim: and the Lord delivered into his hand Chusarsathaim king of Syria of the rivers, and his hand prevailed against Chusarsathaim.

translations.lxx: And the Spirit of the Lord came upon him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war against Chusarsathaim: and the Lord delivered into his hand Chusarsathaim king of Syria of the rivers, and his hand prevailed against Chusarsathaim.
translations.kjv: And the Spirit of the LORD came upon him, and he judged Israel, and went out to war: and the LORD delivered Chushanrishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand; and his hand prevailed against Chushanrishathaim.
translations.ron: Şi a fost Duhul Domnului peste acesta şi a fost el judecător lui Israel. Acesta a ieşit la război împotriva lui Cuşan-Rişeataim şi Domnul a dat în mâinile lui pe Cuşan-Rişeataim, regele Mesopotamiei, şi a apăsat mâna lui pe Cuşan-Rişeataim.

verses.geez: ወአዕረፈት ፡ ምድር ፡ ኀምሳ ፡ ዓመተ ፡ ወሞተ ፡ ጎቶኒየል ፡ ወልደ ፡ ቄኔዝ ።
verses.translation: And the land was quiet forty years; and Gothoniel the son of Kenez died.

translations.lxx: And the land was quiet forty years; and Gothoniel the son of Kenez died.
translations.kjv: And the land had rest forty years. And Othniel the son of Kenaz died.
translations.ron: După aceea s-a odihnit ţara patruzeci de ani şi apoi a murit Otniel, fiul lui Chenaz.

verses.geez:
ወደገሙ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ገቢረ ፡ እኩይ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአጽንዖ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለኤግሎም ፡ ንጉሠ
                  ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ እስመ ፡ ገብሩ ፡ እኪተ ፡ ቅድመ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel continued to do evil before the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglom king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil before the Lord.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel continued to do evil before the Lord: and the Lord strengthened Eglom king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil before the Lord.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel did evil again in the sight of the LORD: and the LORD strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done evil in the sight of the LORD.
translations.ron: Apoi fiii lui Israel iarăşi s-au apucat să facă rele înaintea ochilor Domnului şi a întărit Domnul pe Eglon, regele Moabului, împotriva Israeliţilor, pentru că ei făceau rele înaintea ochilor Domnului.

verses.geez:
ወኦስተጋብአ ፡ ላዕሌሆሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ ዐሞን ፡ ወዐማሌቅ ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ወቀተሎሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወተወርሰ ፡ ሀገረ ፡
                  ፊኒቆን ።
verses.translation: And he gathered to himself all the children of Ammon and Amalec, and went and smote Israel, and took possession of the city of Palm-trees.

translations.lxx: And he gathered to himself all the children of Ammon and Amalec, and went and smote Israel, and took possession of the city of Palm-trees.
translations.kjv: And he gathered unto him the children of Ammon and Amalek, and went and smote Israel, and possessed the city of palm trees.
translations.ron: Şi a adunat acela la sine pe toţi Moabiţii şi Amaleciţii şi a plecat să lovească pe Israel; şi au luat cetatea Palmierilor.

verses.geez: ወተቀንዩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለኤግሎም ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ዐሠርተ ፡ ወሰማንተ ፡ ዓመተ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel served Eglom the king of Moab eighteen years.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel served Eglom the king of Moab eighteen years.
translations.kjv: So the children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.
translations.ron: Iar fiii lui Israel au slujit lui Eglon, regele Moabului, optsprezece ani.

verses.geez:
ወገዐሩ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኀበ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ወአቀመ ፡ ሎሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ መድኀኒተ ፡ ናኦድ ፡ ወልደ ፡
                  ጌራ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ኢያሜኒ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ዘክልኤሆን ፡ እደዊሁ ፡ የማኑ ፡ ወፈነዉ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ አምኃ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡
                  ለዔግሎም ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሞአብ ።
verses.translation: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord; and he raised up to them a saviour, Aod the son of Gera a son of Jemeni, a man who used both hands alike: and the children of Israel sent gifts by his hand to Eglom king of Moab.

translations.lxx: And the children of Israel cried to the Lord; and he raised up to them a saviour, Aod the son of Gera a son of Jemeni, a man who used both hands alike: and the children of Israel sent gifts by his hand to Eglom king of Moab.
translations.kjv: But when the children of Israel cried unto the LORD, the LORD raised them up a deliverer, Ehud the son of Gera, a Benjamite, a man lefthanded: and by him the children of Israel sent a present unto Eglon the king of Moab.
translations.ron: Atunci au strigat fiii lui Israel către Domnul şi Domnul le-a ridicat ca izbăvitor pe Aod, fiul lui Ghera, din neamul lui Veniamin, care era stângaci. Şi au trimis fiii lui Israel prin el daruri lui Eglon, regele Moabului.

verses.geez:
ወገብረ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ ናኦድ ፡ መጥባሕተ ፡ እንተ ፡ ክልኤቱ ፡ አፈዊሃ ፡ እንተ ፡ ሥዝር ፡ ኑኃ ፡ ወቀነታ ፡ ታሕተ ፡ ቅናቱ
                  ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሐቌሁ ፡ መንገለ ፡ የማኑ ።
verses.translation: And Aod made himself a dagger of two edges, of a span long, and he girded it under his cloak upon his right thigh.

translations.lxx: And Aod made himself a dagger of two edges, of a span long, and he girded it under his cloak upon his right thigh.
translations.kjv: But Ehud made him a dagger which had two edges, of a cubit length; and he did gird it under his raiment upon his right thigh.
translations.ron: Aod şi-a făcut sabie cu două ascuţişuri, lungă de un cot şi a încins-o sub mantaua sa la şoldul drept

verses.geez: ወአብአ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አምኃሁ ፡ ለኤግሎም ፡ ንጉሠ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ ወኤግሎምሰ ፡ ቈጢጥ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ጥቀ ።
verses.translation: And he went, and brought the presents to Eglom king of Moab, and Eglom was a very handsome man.

translations.lxx: And he went, and brought the presents to Eglom king of Moab, and Eglom was a very handsome man.
translations.kjv: And he brought the present unto Eglon king of Moab: and Eglon was a very fat man.
translations.ron: Şi a mers cu daruri la Eglon, regele Moabului. Eglon însă era om foarte gras.

verses.geez: ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ ፈጸመ ፡ ናኦድ ፡ አብኦ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ አምኃሁ ፡ ፈነዎሙ ፡ ለእለ ፡ ጾሩ ፡ አምኃሁ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when Aod had made an end of offering his gifts, that he dismissed those that brought the gifts.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when Aod had made an end of offering his gifts, that he dismissed those that brought the gifts.
translations.kjv: And when he had made an end to offer the present, he sent away the people that bare the present.
translations.ron: După ce a înfăţişat Aod toate darurile, a dat drumul oamenilor care aduseseră darurile,

verses.geez:
ወገብአ ፡ ኤግሎም ፡ እምነ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አማልክት ፡ ምስለ ፡ ገልገል ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ [ናኦድ ፡] ብየ ፡ ነገረ ፡ ኀቤከ ፡
                  ንጉሥ ፡ እንተ ፡ ባሕቲትከ ፡ ወአዘዘ ፡ ዔግሎም ፡ ይፃእ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ እምኀቤሁ ፡ ወወፅኡ ፡ ኵሎሙ ፡ እለ ፡ ይቀውሙ ፡ ኀቤሁ
                  ።
verses.translation: And he himself returned from the quarries that are by Galgal; and Aod said, I have a secret errand to thee, O king! and Eglom said to him, Be silent: and he sent away from his presence all who waited upon him.

translations.lxx: And he himself returned from the quarries that are by Galgal; and Aod said, I have a secret errand to thee, O king! and Eglom said to him, Be silent: and he sent away from his presence all who waited upon him.
translations.kjv: But he himself turned again from the quarries that were by Gilgal, and said, I have a secret errand unto thee, O king: who said, Keep silence. And all that stood by him went out from him.
translations.ron: Iar el însuşi, întorcându-se de la idolii de lângă Ghilgal, a zis regelui: "Cuvânt în taină am a-ţi spune, o rege!" Iar el a zis: "Mai încet!" Atunci au ieşit de la dânsul toţi cei ce stăteau pe lângă el.

verses.geez:
ወቦአ ፡ ናኦድ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወይነብር ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሑ ፡ ወሐጋይ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ናኦድ ፡ ብየ
                  ፡ ዘእነግረከ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወተንሥአ ፡ ኤግሎም ፡ እምነ ፡ መንበሩ ፡ ወቀርቦ ።
verses.translation: And Aod went in to him; and he sat in his own upper summer chamber quite alone; and Aod said, I have a message from God to thee, O king: and Eglom rose up from his throne near him.

translations.lxx: And Aod went in to him; and he sat in his own upper summer chamber quite alone; and Aod said, I have a message from God to thee, O king: and Eglom rose up from his throne near him.
translations.kjv: And Ehud came unto him; and he was sitting in a summer parlour, which he had for himself alone. And Ehud said, I have a message from God unto thee. And he arose out of his seat.
translations.ron: Şi a intrat Aod la dânsul; căci el şedea într-un foişor răcoros, pe care îl avea acolo la o parte. Şi a zis Aod: "Eu, o rege, am către tine un cuvânt al lui Dumnezeu". Atunci Eglon s-a sculat de pe scaun înaintea lui.

verses.geez:
ወሶበ ፡ ተንሥአ ፡ አልዐለ ፡ ናኦድ ፡ እዴሁ ፡ እንተ ፡ ፀጋም ፡ ወመልኀ ፡ መጥባሕቶ ፡ እምነ ፡ ገቦሁ ፡ ዘየማን ፡
                  ወረገዞ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ከርሡ ፡ ለኤግሎም ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass as he arose, that Aod stretched forth his left hand, and took the dagger off his right thigh, and plunged it into his belly;

translations.lxx: And it came to pass as he arose, that Aod stretched forth his left hand, and took the dagger off his right thigh, and plunged it into his belly;
translations.kjv: And Ehud put forth his left hand, and took the dagger from his right thigh, and thrust it into his belly:
translations.ron: Şi când s-a sculat el, Aod şi-a întins mâna sa stângă şi a scos sabia de la coapsa sa dreaptă şi a împlântat-o în pântecele lui,

verses.geez: ወአብኣ ፡ ሎቱ ፡ እስከ ፡ ለዐታ ፡ ወበረሮ ፡ እስከ ፡ ዘባኑ ፡ ወመልኀ ፡ መጥባኅቶ ፡ እምነ ፡ ከርሡ ።
verses.translation: and drove in also the haft after the blade, and the fat closed in upon the blade, for he drew not out the dagger from his belly.

translations.lxx: and drove in also the haft after the blade, and the fat closed in upon the blade, for he drew not out the dagger from his belly.
translations.kjv: And the haft also went in after the blade; and the fat closed upon the blade, so that he could not draw the dagger out of his belly; and the dirt came out.
translations.ron: Aşa încât a intrat după ascuţişul sabiei şi mânerul şi grăsimea a acoperit rana pe unde intrase sabia, căci Aod n-a scos-o din pântecele lui.

verses.geez: ወወፅአ ፡ ናዖድ ፡ ጸናፌ ፡ ወዐጸወ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ጽርሕ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ወቀተረ ።
verses.translation: And Aod went out to the porch, and passed out by the appointed guards, and shut the doors of the chamber upon him, and locked them.

translations.lxx: And Aod went out to the porch, and passed out by the appointed guards, and shut the doors of the chamber upon him, and locked them.
translations.kjv: Then Ehud went forth through the porch, and shut the doors of the parlour upon him, and locked them.
translations.ron: Apoi Aod a ieşit în tindă, trăgând după sine uşa foişorului şi încuind-o.

verses.geez:
ወወፂኦ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቦኡ ፡ ደቁ ፡ ወርእዩ ፡ ወረከቡ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ዘጽርሕ ፡ ዕጽወ ፡ ወይቤሉ ፡ ዮጊ ፡ ባሕቲቱ ፡ ይነብር
                  ፡ ጽመ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምግሓሠ ፡ ጽርሑ ፡ ቅስፈ ።
verses.translation: And he went out: and Eglom's servants came, and saw, and behold, the doors of the upper chamber were locked; and they said, Does he not uncover his feet in the summer-chamber?

translations.lxx: And he went out: and Eglom's servants came, and saw, and behold, the doors of the upper chamber were locked; and they said, Does he not uncover his feet in the summer-chamber?
translations.kjv: When he was gone out, his servants came; and when they saw that, behold, the doors of the parlour were locked, they said, Surely he covereth his feet in his summer chamber.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a ieşit el, au venit slugile lui Eglon şi, văzând uşa foişorului încuiată, au zis: "Se vede că el îşi acoperă picioarele În camera de vară".

verses.geez:
ወፀንሑ ፡ እስመ ፡ ኀፍሩ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘአርኀዎሙ ፡ ኆኅተ ፡ ጽርሕ ፡ ወነሥኡ ፡ መርኆ ፡ ወአርኀዉ ፡ ወረከብዎ ፡
                  ለእግዚኦሙ ፡ ውዱቀ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድር ፡ ምውተ ።
verses.translation: And they waited till they were ashamed, and, behold, there was no one that opened the doors of the upper chamber; and they took the key, and opened them; and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead upon the earth.

translations.lxx: And they waited till they were ashamed, and, behold, there was no one that opened the doors of the upper chamber; and they took the key, and opened them; and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead upon the earth.
translations.kjv: And they tarried till they were ashamed: and, behold, he opened not the doors of the parlour; therefore they took a key, and opened them: and, behold, their lord was fallen down dead on the earth.
translations.ron: Şi au aşteptat ei destulă vreme; dar văzând că nu mai deschide nimeni uşa foişorului, au adus o cheie şi au deschis şi iată stăpânul lor zăcea mort la pământ.

verses.geez:
ወናኦድሰ ፡ አምሰጠ ፡ እስከ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ይትሀወኩ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘአእመሮ ፡ ወውእቱሰ ፡ ኀለፈ ፡ እምነ ፡ አማልክቲሆሙ
                  ፡ ወአምሰጠ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ሴይሮታ ።
verses.translation: And Aod escaped while they were in a tumult, and no one paid attention to him; and he passed the quarries, and escaped to Setirotha.

translations.lxx: And Aod escaped while they were in a tumult, and no one paid attention to him; and he passed the quarries, and escaped to Setirotha.
translations.kjv: And Ehud escaped while they tarried, and passed beyond the quarries, and escaped unto Seirath.
translations.ron: Până să se dumirească aceia, Aod a plecat şi nimeni nu se mai gândea la el; a trecut pe lângă idoli şi a scăpat în Seira.

verses.geez:
ወእምዝ ፡ ሶበ ፡ በጽሐ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምድረ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወነፍኀ ፡ ቀርነ ፡ በውስተ ፡ ደብረ ፡ ኤፍሬም ፡ ወወረዱ ፡
                  ምስሌሁ ፡ እምነ ፡ ደብር ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ቅድሜሆሙ ።
verses.translation: And it came to pass when Aod came into the land of Israel, that he blew the horn in mount Ephraim, and the children of Israel came down with him from the mountain, and he was before them.

translations.lxx: And it came to pass when Aod came into the land of Israel, that he blew the horn in mount Ephraim, and the children of Israel came down with him from the mountain, and he was before them.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when he was come, that he blew a trumpet in the mountain of Ephraim, and the children of Israel went down with him from the mount, and he before them.
translations.ron: Iar după ce a venit în ţara lui Israel, Aod a trâmbiţat din trâmbiţă pe muntele Efraim şi s-au coborât la dânsul fiii lui Israel din muntele Efraim şi el mergea înaintea lor.

verses.geez:
ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ረዱ ፡ ትልውኒ ፡ እስመ ፡ አግብኦሙ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለፀርነ ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴነ ፡ ለሞአብ ፡ ወወረዱ ፡
                  ወተለውዎ ፡ ወበጽሑ ፡ ማዕዶተ ፡ ዮርዳንስ ፡ ዘሞአብ ፡ ወኢያብሑ ፡ ሰብእ ፡ ይዕዱ ።
verses.translation: And he said to them, Come down after me, for the Lord God has delivered our enemies, even Moab, into our hand; and they went down after him, and seized on the fords of Jordan before Moab, and he did not suffer a man to pass over.

translations.lxx: And he said to them, Come down after me, for the Lord God has delivered our enemies, even Moab, into our hand; and they went down after him, and seized on the fords of Jordan before Moab, and he did not suffer a man to pass over.
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, Follow after me: for the LORD hath delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand. And they went down after him, and took the fords of Jordan toward Moab, and suffered not a man to pass over.
translations.ron: Şi ţa zis el către dânşii: "Veniţi după mine, că a dat Domnul pe vrăjmaşii noştri Moabiţi în mâinile voastre". Şi s-au dus după dânsul şi au apucat vadul Iordanului spre Moab şi nu au lăsat pe nimeni să treacă.

verses.geez:
ወቀተልዎሙ ፡ ለሞአብ ፡ በእማንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ የአክል ፡ እልፈ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ መስተቃትላነ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ዕደወ ፡
                  ኀይሎሙ ፡ ወአልቦ ፡ ዘአምሰጠ ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፡ ወኢ፩ብእሲ ።
verses.translation: And they smote Moab on that day about ten thousand men, every lusty person and every mighty man; and not a man escaped.

translations.lxx: And they smote Moab on that day about ten thousand men, every lusty person and every mighty man; and not a man escaped.
translations.kjv: And they slew of Moab at that time about ten thousand men, all lusty, and all men of valour; and there escaped not a man.
translations.ron: Şi au ucis atunci din Moabiţi până la zece mii de oameni, toţi sănătoşi şi voinici, încât nimeni n-a scăpat.

verses.geez:
ወገብኡ ፡ ሞአብ ፡ በእማንቱ ፡ መዋዕል ፡ ውስተ ፡ እዴሆሙ ፡ ለእስራኤል ፡ ወአዕረፈት ፡ ምድር ፡ ሰማንያ ፡ ዓመተ ፡
                  ወኰነኖሙ ፡ ናኦድ ፡ እስከ ፡ ሞተ ።
verses.translation: So Moab was humbled in that day under the hand of Israel, and the land had rest eighty years; and Aod judged them till he died.

translations.lxx: So Moab was humbled in that day under the hand of Israel, and the land had rest eighty years; and Aod judged them till he died.
translations.kjv: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. And the land had rest fourscore years.
translations.ron: Aşa au fost supuşi în ziua aceea Moabiţii înaintea lui Israel şi s-a liniştit ţara lui optzeci de ani. Iar Aod a fost judecătorul lor până la moartea sa.

verses.geez:
ወእምድኅረ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ቆመ ፡ ሴሜገር ፡ ወልደ ፡ ሐነት ፡ ወቀተሎሙ ፡ ለአሎፊል ፡ ስድስተ ፡ ምእተ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ በኀበ ፡
                  ማሕረሰ ፡ ላህሙ ፤ ወውእቱኒ ፡ አድኀኖሙ ፡ [ለእስራኤል ፡]፡
verses.translation: And after him rose up Samegar the son of Dinach, and smote the Philistines to the number of six hundred men with a ploughshare such as is drawn by oxen; and he too delivered Israel.

translations.lxx: And after him rose up Samegar the son of Dinach, and smote the Philistines to the number of six hundred men with a ploughshare such as is drawn by oxen; and he too delivered Israel.
translations.kjv: And after him was Shamgar the son of Anath, which slew of the Philistines six hundred men with an ox goad: and he also delivered Israel.
translations.ron: După dânsul a fost judecător Şamgar, fiul lui Anat, care a ucis şase sute de Filisteni cu un băţ, cu bold de mânat boii, şi acesta a izbăvit de asemenea pe Israel.
